vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Coordinate approved nonclinical furniture moves and maintain item-location records.
requirements.zh: 协调获批非临床家具搬移，并维护物品位置记录。

requirements.en: Reconcile tagged stock and escalate damage or unresolved ownership and destination questions.
requirements.zh: 核对带标签库存，并升级上报损坏或未解决归属及目的位置问题。

requirements.en: Confirm deliveries and prepare clear facilities handovers.
requirements.zh: 确认配送，并准备清晰设施事务交接。
